summary: Six children, ages 6-17, reported missing at Topaz Mountain, Park County; a SARDOC dog team was responding but did not field as the group was located by a deputy at Tarryall Reservoir.
responding_agency: Park County Sheriff's Office; SARDOC (air-scent dog team, stood down en route)
notes: SARDOC dog team responding but did not field; group located by deputy at Tarryall Reservoir. Inserted via run-795 backfill chunk C (SARDOC 2017 PDF).
